outcome: Decrease in beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (b-hCG) level
Increase in blood C-reactive protein level
cohort: 39 patients with type II and III cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) who underwent surgical treatment at Hubei Maternal and Child Health Hospital between June 2018 and June 2021.
finding: Transumbilical single-port laparoscopy (TSPLS) resulted in significantly better scar cosmesis but a slightly longer operative time compared to traditional laparoscopy, with no significant differences in other surgical or postoperative recovery outcomes.
